videos.headline: Keelon Russell commits second turnover of game with INT
Keelon Russell scores first TD of the game for Alabama
Tennessee muffed punt sets Alabama up in great field position
Alabama fumbles in the red zone after botched handoff
George MacIntyre throws early interception against Alabama
DeSean Bishop fights across the goal line to pad Tennessee's lead
